trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, failing health checks.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy production status — to all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** was created for checkout-api, documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recovery verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting any re-deploy.
